value.rationale: A natural small nonplanar graph produces an actual non-split integral dihedral rank-two lattice invisible over rationals, and sharply distinct rational Betti numbers for three symmetry quotients. This is a precise topological and representation-theoretic invariant relevant to two-particle graph motion, with a reproducible complete finite calculation rather than a routine rank-only table.
